text: Artificial intelligence, or AI, refers to computer systems designed to perform tasks that normally require human intelligence. At its core, AI enables machines to learn from data and improve over time. Machine learning is a key part of this, where computers analyze examples to identify patterns without being explicitly programmed. Deep learning is a more advanced subset that uses neural networks to process complex information, such as images or speech. You encounter AI daily in voice assistants, social media recommendations, and navigation apps. From suggesting movies to translating languages, AI is becoming a helpful tool in our everyday routines.
